rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: A family game of hide-and-seek ends with Alex never coming out of hiding, and the restricted wing of Vanderhouven Manor gives up the family secret. Pandora and Russ learn their family is cursed, and their father turns to stone in front of them.
rows.resolution: Scared and worried, the kids finally hear the truth their parents hid, and sharing the family history is what makes it lighter to face.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: a father turns to stone and the kids learn the family is cursed; spooky mansion tone, nothing graphic.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: The golden baboon head gets loose from the restricted wing, and the family hunts it room by room through the manor. Sky wants to face the danger alone; letting Pandora and Russ help turns out to be the winning call.
rows.resolution: The fear of a snarling artifact on the loose meets asking for help, and Sky learns that letting her kids help beats facing danger alone.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the escaped artifact is a snarling baboon head that trashes rooms.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: Mokey follows a bizarre dream's inner map to a once-in-a-generation event. The trip lands the gang in the dangerous Echo Chamber, and the Merggle Moon Migration passes them by.
rows.resolution: Scared is how she feels each time; trying again is what she does, and with family beside her she proves you can do a scary thing scared.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: booby traps, temple bats, and a spooky roadside illusion; the curse is not yet broken, ending on hope.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: Three fertility statues come to life, and suddenly Russ, Pandora and Sky are babysitters to three Olmec babies who need reuniting with their mother on display at the Paxton Museum. Caring for little ones is harder and sweeter than any of them imagined.
rows.resolution: The frustration of the baby chaos settles into patience, and the pride lands when they learn what parents know: when someone you love needs you, you just figure it out.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: a museum heist sequence played for comedy; Russ faces his fear of tight spaces.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: A ritual might be the way to reach Alex, and Pandora and Russ rush it without reading all the instructions. The shortcut sets a creature loose, and Stanley gets caught in the center of the chaos.
rows.resolution: Guilty and worried, they learn that hope is not a reason to skip steps; patience is part of love, and good friends forgive honest mistakes.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: a shadowy messenger creature stalks the dark; Stanley is briefly trapped alone.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: Pandora is pulled into a haunted painting born of an artist's five-hundred-year-old jealous quarrel, and faceless spirits close in around her. Owning her own jealousy of Russ, it turns out, is the key that gets everyone free.
rows.resolution: Jealousy named out loud is the move that breaks the spell, and the lonely spiral inside the painting ends in an apology to a sibling.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: faceless spirits (Noppera-bō) pursue characters inside a painting, named as Japanese folklore.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: A stormy Scottish island and a puzzling local are just the start; the Vanderhouvens find a selkie whose sealskin was stolen. Storm and shipwreck peril follow the family across the island.
rows.resolution: The worry of the storm gets talked out on the way, and the kids learn that some sadness is about loss, not behavior, and that they can be strong for their mom when she carries too much.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: storm and shipwreck peril; selkie folklore handled respectfully.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: Russ's puzzle obsession pulls him inside a memory of Cornelius Vanderhouven, where he learns the truth about his ancestor the hard way. The memory belongs to a villain, and it does not want to let him go.
rows.resolution: The fear of being trapped inside someone else's past ends in asking for help, and the family learns that brilliance needs brakes and that no one gets to face danger alone.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: Russ is trapped inside a magical memory by a villainous ancestor; peril played straight.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: A witch in the Yucatan jungle has a protective amulet the family needs, and she has her own reason to punish Vanderhouvens. Captured, Pandora and Russ pay for what their ancestor did.
rows.resolution: The fear of being punished for an ancestor's crime meets standing up for yourself, and Pandora's calm, brave answer is how the kids learn the difference between justice and revenge.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the kids are held captive by a witch whose garden they cannot leave; her daughter was petrified by the curse.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: Freeing Alex from the stone curse means facing a giant black widow and accepting that someone might have to be turned to stone in his place. The challenge pushes the Vanderhouvens to their limits.
rows.resolution: Scared as they are, the family keeps its promise to stick together, and asking for help is what brings Alex back; hope, they learn, is why Larry is still alive.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: a giant spider stalks the family and a parent is nearly lost; the scariest episode of the season with a triumphant ending.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: In a Transylvanian castle, the Vanderhouvens find skeleton miners forced to work by a greedy heir. The parents want to keep the kids safe the old way, on the sidelines.
rows.resolution: The fear of the castle and its mines meets asking for help, and the parents learn that facing danger together works better, because no one in this family sits out a rescue.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: enslaved skeleton miners and a cruel heir; Dad's recurring nightmares signal something is still wrong.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: A manticore crashes Pandora's game night and turns the sleepover into a maze of risky challenges, with mouth-losing stakes. The secret she has been keeping, the bonkers family-curse part, is the thing her friendship gets tested against.
rows.resolution: Worried about what her friend will think, Pandora talks it out instead, and the friendship survives the truth, even the family-curse part.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the game threatens to take away a player's mouth, played as fantasy stakes; kids in real danger during the maze.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: Larry leads a mission honoring Admiral Sadik's final request, and his hero worship runs straight into the admiral's real record of abandoning his crew. Chaos follows on the Aegean, along with a vengeful ghost sailor.
rows.resolution: Disappointed is what Larry feels about the hero; apologizing is what he does about his own crew, and a sorry said out loud steers the friendship home.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: a vengeful ghost sailor attacks the boat; no one is hurt.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: A possessed marionette takes control of Russ and silences him, demanding a family legacy nobody in the family chose. In India, Muskaan teaches the kids what a parent's dream actually is.
rows.resolution: The scared silence of a kid controlled by someone else's plan ends in standing up for yourself: the gift of a parent's dream is a choice, not an order, and saying what you love out loud can break a curse.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: Russ is puppet-controlled and unable to speak, freed unharmed; family-legacy pressure is the theme.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: Strange whispers cycle through the house, and the Vanderhouvens hear their loved ones say their worst fears out loud. The curse has found the family's doubts and turned up the volume.
rows.resolution: The voices sound like anxious self-talk, and the family answers with written truth, because doubts only win when you hand them the microphone; the fear gets reframed, not obeyed.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: characters hear loved ones voice cruel insecurities because of a curse, which lands like anxious self-talk; resolved with truthful affirmations.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: An Old West artifact reignites a vengeful gang of cowboy spirits in New Mexico, and a ghost jury holds the family until the Goodluck brothers' wrongful conviction is proved. Digging up the truth is the only way out.
rows.resolution: Scared but determined, the kids learn that fixing an old injustice is possible when you dig up the truth, ask for help and hand it to the right people.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: ghost cowboy peril, including Margie briefly turning spectral; Black cowboy history (the Goodluck brothers and Bud) is a proud throughline.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: In Australia, a cursed didgeridoo makes the birds attack, and the cure is a song nobody can find until Stanley feels it through his vibrations. The quiet friend gets the brave job.
rows.resolution: The worry of a cure nobody can reach ends in trying again, and the family learns to trust a quiet friend to do a brave thing alone and to trust nature's balance.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: A mysterious tonic shrinks the Vanderhouven kids to the size of a snack for Linda the lizard, and their possessed dad sprayed it. The sprint is on before Linda decides they are food.
rows.resolution: Anger and fear run through the shrunk-down sprint, and the family traces the curse to Diana Cameron, an orphan who stood up to a cheating salesman, because it takes strength to stand up to a bully.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: the kids are shrunk and hunted by Linda the bearded dragon, unharmed; their father, while possessed, lies to them and endangers them; the backstory features an orphan girl cheated by a snake-oil salesman.

rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: Sky stands accused of a theft she did not commit, and the kids discover their father is the real thief in body only. Cornelius, the villainous ancestor, is inside him.
rows.resolution: The angry, scared family fights a curse it cannot see by believing each other, and standing up for yourself is how Sky answers a false accusation.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. rows.series_title: Curses!
rows.story_lead: A villain from the past breaks into the Paxton Museum to take control of Alex forever, and the family storms the basement to stop him. Cornelius has all the magic; the family has each other.
rows.resolution: The fear of losing Dad for good meets asking for help, and the family proves that a villain with all the magic is still weaker than people who fight for each other.
rows.evidence_note: Script: dev set row note reads 'script-verified (Gestdown subtitles, identity-checked)'; confidence high. Content consideration carried: possession, a soul-transfer throne, and the threat that Dad will cease to exist; resolved with the family together and Cornelius gone.

rows.series_title: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
rows.story_lead: Only one snowflake arrives for the Fraggles' first-snow celebration. To make matters worse, the yearly holiday song is still unwritten. Gobo does what no Fraggle has done before and leaves the Rock for Outer Space to find the music.
rows.resolution: The song comes together in its own way. While the holiday moment is not perfect, it turns out to be as unique and memorable as a snowflake.

rows.story_lead: The garden's fate rides on one windmill, and there is no wind to turn it. Red goes from hopeful to nopeful and back, rallying one more idea from a tired Rock.
rows.resolution: The frustration of a fix that will not fix meets trying again, and hope turns out to be a game you play every day, one fix at a time, until the garden breathes again.
